interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The barrow debt
interactives.text: Eleven breached, eleven return fields left blank. What is made over the court is entered against the debt and counts double.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The shrine's under-room. Books read three times as fast in the peat-quiet.

interactives.label: The debt
interactives.text: A debt-reader reads a barrow's kerb the way a clerk reads a ledger. The eleventh kerb has a stone missing.

interactives.label: Bog iron
interactives.text: Bog iron is harvested with nothing but hands; it is the smelting that wants the pickaxe.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The eleven
interactives.text: Eleven barrows breached in one winter, and nothing taken from any of them but the kerb stones.

interactives.label: The fifth chamber
interactives.text: The fifth chamber is a false barrow: built empty, sealed full.

interactives.label: The blank fields
interactives.text: A blank return field is not a debt unpaid. It is a debt nobody will name.

interactives.label: The West Crypt Reliquary
interactives.text: Opened with bones, as the crypts are.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Daily work
interactives.text: Mora Fen's ghost orchids grow in one patch on this moor. A task names the patch; look for the flowers, not the tile.

sections.name: The Peat Hollow
sections.label: A cairn built over nothing, or over something.
sections.note: A cutting the peat men roofed over: dry peat and bog iron in the same wall.

sections.name: The Croft Garden
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A croft's sunken garden where cotton and bramble grow out of the wind.

sections.name: The Boardwalk Cache
sections.label: A hide of cut reeds, and a plank floor under it where there should be mud.
sections.note: A dry cell under the boardwalk: chest, bench and the nodules the smith hides from the reader.

sections.name: The Barrow Court Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The court's strongroom, under the great barrow's kerb.

sections.name: The Hound Pit
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: A tower cellar where the wardens pen hounds for the young to learn on.

sections.name: The Moor Shrine School
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Where the debt-readers learn to read kerbs.

sections.name: The Hanged Oak Spring
sections.label: A hollow tree. The dark inside it goes down, not in.
sections.note: Under the hanged oak a warm seep the moor never froze; wounds close to it.

sections.name: The Stone Ring Butts
sections.label: A cairn built over nothing, or over something.
sections.note: A gallery under the ring; ponies at the far end for slow shots.

sections.name: The West Crypt Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: Opened with bones, as the crypts are.

sections.name: The Barrow Well
sections.label: A cairn built over nothing, or over something.
sections.note: Granite and peat swallow every spell here; the wolves penned below never needed one.

sections.name: The Wisp Focus
sections.label: A cairn built over nothing, or over something.
sections.note: Where the wisps gather the ether pools; spells cost half.

sections.name: The Peat-Cut
sections.label: A hide of cut reeds, and a plank floor under it where there should be mud.
sections.note: The peat men's cut under the border, out onto Westhaven's upland.

sections.name: The Moor Waystone
sections.label: A cairn built over nothing, or over something.
sections.note: Four stones under the ring. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Tower Eyrie
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: A pocket in the east tower's footing.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 14 secrets of Grey Moors Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
